native.scope: Actual native Router with synthetic transport, original-shaped160K system text, Haiku source model and40000 count response; count request is admitted before evaluator and both responses overlap. Existing original replay checks tiny and enabled-thinking hard lock issue no count transport.

native_API_review.preserved: For the admitted suspicious input, count starts before evaluation; the Haiku result is retained. Tiny and hard-locked requests skip count.
native_API_review.migration: Source immediately invokes caller-owned countTokens callback before fetchImpl. Rust polls its owned TokenCounter future before Classifier::classify, using a one-shot start acknowledgement. No callback/Promise object identity is claimed.
native_API_review.capacity_limit: Bounded advisory-capacity exhaustion may skip speculative count and classify first; the original definition does not exercise saturation. No universal order claim is made.
native_API_review.performance_limit: This handshake places first-poll serialization/cache work before evaluator admission. The unchanged speed gates remain unmeasured for this source.
